subject: general
question: The sum of all interior angles of a regular polygon is 1620°. What is the measure (in degrees) of its each exterior angle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of **interior angles** = 1620°

Number of **triangles** formed (n − 2) = 1620 ÷ 180 = 9

Number of **sides** (n) = 9 + 2 = 11

Each **exterior angle** = 360° ÷ n = 360° ÷ 11 = 32 8/11°

**∴ The correct answer is 32 8/11°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of all **interior angles** of a **regular polygon** = 1620°

**Formula Used:**

1. Sum of **interior angles** = (n − 2) × 180°

2. Each **exterior angle** = 360° ÷ n

Where **n** is the number of sides of the polygon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bde194b154edfe0d239da493d02b5f53e4af55008559e2c0f20135d6f416e23b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (n − 2) × 180° = 1620°

⇒ n − 2 = 1620 ÷ 180

⇒ n − 2 = 9

⇒ n = 9 + 2 = 11

⇒ Each **exterior angle** = 360° ÷ 11

⇒ Each **exterior angle** = 32 8/11°

**∴ The correct answer is 32 8/11°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of the **exterior angles** of any convex polygon, taking one at each vertex, is always **360°**.

Interior and Exterior Angle Relation

At any vertex of a polygon, the **Interior Angle + Exterior Angle = 180°** (Linear Pair).

Number of Diagonals

The number of **diagonals** in a polygon with **n** sides is given by the formula: **n(n − 3) ÷ 2**.</p
